objective: Keep LIFE and Kabihasnang Ligaw permanently visible as independent cards in the public Wall, removing the Community highlights accordion without changing card destinations or adjacent Marites, ad, or feed behavior.
productionBaselineEvidence: Derived from latest SALIKSIK + Home/Profile visual staging stack. Main and production untouched; source-only staging PR. No compiled RC, OTA, native rebuild, database change or web/prod publish authorized.
chosenApproach: Surgically remove only the local communityHighlightsOpen state, collapsible header, and conditional view wrapper; preserve the same mounted LIFE and KL card components, order, sponsorship and Marites.
selectionRationale: The original cards already have working navigation and presentation; an always-visible direct render removes needless taps and keeps media, permissions and backend unchanged.
alternativeApproaches: Start the accordion expanded but retain its collapse button: rejected because the cards could still be hidden.
Duplicate LIFE/KL into Home and Drawer: rejected due navigation duplication and media overhead.
preserveBehaviors: LIFE and KL card component internals, links and approved content unchanged.
Sponsored campaign and first-view ad stay above both cards; Marites and the Community composer stay below.
No impact to Profile/Home, Connect, production, backend, AdMob revenue calculations or private roles.
No new native API or package, no changes to animation/video autoplay policies.
acceptanceChecks: Direct cards are present once, in stable order without drawer gating.
Node regression test passes; TypeScript and Expo staging Android export pass on exact head.
Staging Android OTA cannot publish until PR integration, exact signed runtime and physical-device visual verification.
Never touch web or production unless separately authorized.
